name: 4Sum
description: Given an array nums of n integers, return an array of all the unique quadruplets [nums[a], nums[b], nums[c], nums[d]] such that: 0 <= a, b, c, d < n, a, b, c, and d are distinct, nums[a] + nums[b] + nums[c] + nums[d] == target. You may return the answer in any order.
shortDescription: Find all unique quadruplets that sum to target
